evidence.title: A retiree helps track down Pa.’s abandoned oil wells

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well inventories and estimates
occurrences.quote_span: Pennsylvania has thousands of these wells. The full number is unknown, but estimates range from around 20,000 to as high as 750,000.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Spotlight PA analysis of Pennsylvania abandoned-well plugging costs
occurrences.quote_span: A Spotlight PA analysis previously found that the cost to plug each well was roughly $100,000.
occurrences.speaker: Spotlight PA analysis
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania oil and gas bonding requirements and well-plugging cost records
occurrences.quote_span: However, the cost of a bond is only $2,500 for a single conventional well or $25,000 for multiple conventional wells, while the cost of plugging a well ranges from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of dollars.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania DEP grant and expenditure records
occurrences.quote_span: Alongside those funds, the state also used federal money from the EPA, Department of Energy, and U.S. Forest Service to plug wells.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania oil and gas statutes and regulations
occurrences.quote_span: According to state law, operators of wells are responsible for plugging them.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal disbursement records for Pennsylvania Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act abandoned-well funds
occurrences.quote_span: So far, the state has received just over half of that total sum — about $214 million.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania DEP inventory of unplugged abandoned oil and gas wells
occurrences.quote_span: Even at that accelerated pace, the DEP can’t keep up. Thousands remain unplugged.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Well Done Foundation well-plugging cost estimates
occurrences.quote_span: Shuck estimates that plugging a well can cost anywhere from $60,000 to $400,000.
occurrences.speaker: Curtis Shuck
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania state budget and DEP fund expenditure records
occurrences.quote_span: But that money doesn’t go directly toward paying contractors for plugging; it supports the DEP’s team that manages and inspects oil and gas wells.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania Oil and Gas Act of 1984
occurrences.quote_span: The Pennsylvania Oil and Gas Act of 1984 requires owners and operators to plug their wells within one year of ending production.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Kurt Klapkowski testimony to the Pennsylvania House Environmental Resources and Energy Committee
occurrences.quote_span: In testimony to the state House Environmental Resources and Energy Committee last year, Klapkowski said the average plugging cost had dropped to $69,000.
occurrences.speaker: Kurt Klapkowski
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania DEP orphaned-well verification and mapping procedures
occurrences.quote_span: Those steps, according to Shader, include a field verification, an administrative review of DEP records, and an investigation to ensure there’s no responsible party for the well.
occurrences.speaker: Neil Shader
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act funding allocation records for Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas wells
occurrences.quote_span: In total, Pennsylvania is slated to receive nearly $400 million through 2030.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania oil and gas bonding requirements and well-plugging cost records
occurrences.quote_span: However, the cost of a bond is only $2,500 for a single conventional well or $25,000 for multiple conventional wells, while the cost of plugging a well ranges from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of dollars.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania Oil and Gas Act and Pennsylvania DEP plugging authorities
occurrences.quote_span: When an owner can’t be identified, or when the well is older than the 1984 state law that regulates oil and gas drilling, the Department of Environmental Protection is responsible for the plugging.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania DEP expenditure records for federal abandoned-well funds
occurrences.quote_span: According to DEP spokesperson Neil Shader, Pennsylvania has spent $31.8 million of that as of last July — which has covered the costs of most of the well plugging the agency has done over the past five years.
occurrences.speaker: Neil Shader
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania DEP well-plugging records
occurrences.quote_span: In total, Pennsylvania has plugged nearly 500 wells over the past five years, according to the DEP.
occurrences.speaker: Pennsylvania DEP
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania DEP well-plugging records for 2026
occurrences.quote_span: This year, the state has plugged 113 wells.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging

occurrences.checkable_against: Scientific measurements of methane and carbon dioxide global warming potential
occurrences.quote_span: They can emit methane, a greenhouse gas 25 times more potent at trapping heat in the atmosphere than carbon dioxide, and leak toxic substances that pollute their surroundings.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Pennsylvania abandoned oil and gas well plugging
